name: Right Hand Of God
overview: The phrase 'Right Hand of God' in Scripture signifies a position of supreme authority, power, and honor bestowed by God. Psalms 110:1 and Luke 22:69 reveal that the Son of Man is exalted to sit at God's right hand, indicating His sovereign rule over enemies and all creation. Isaiah 41:10 highlights God's sustaining strength through His righteous right hand, while Acts 5:31 and Romans 8:34 emphasize Christ's exaltation to this place of honor, where He acts as both Savior and intercessor for believers.
